labs.lab_name: Clough Center for the Study of Constitutional Democracy
labs.research_summary: A Boston College center for interdisciplinary and international study of constitutional democracy, run around a yearly theme with fellows, symposia and a journal.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 director, 1 postdoctoral research fellow and center coordinator, 1 graduate assistant
labs.join_notes: The fellowships page lists paid roles and fellowships: doctoral fellowships, junior (undergraduate) fellowships, paid Clough Correspondents, faculty affiliates, a short-term visiting fellow and a postdoctoral research fellow, with the 2027-28 theme Democracy and Religion. Applications go to clough.center@bc.edu; the postdoctoral and visiting fellow deadline shown is December 15, 2026. Doctoral, junior and correspondent deadlines shown (March 31, 2026) have passed.
